shot-01: Slow push-in; the viewer slowly lifts their head toward the empty bleachers. Silent actor, mouth still.
shot-02: The viewer turns slowly in place, looking across the packed rows; slight camera drift. Silent actor.
shot-03: Tala walks steadily up the torch-lit path; lateral tracking. Silent actor.
shot-04: The torches ahead go out one by one; Tala stops and raises her spear. Silent actor.
shot-05: Slow pull-back; Oro counts the seated band with a pointing finger; fire flickers. Silent actors.
shot-06: Time-lapse of light changing across seasons; Pip grows taller, still holding the wooden bird. Silent actors.
shot-07: Tala presses her hand on cracked mud; dust blows past; slight push-in. Silent actor.
shot-08: The herd runs away into the distance; Tala slowly lowers her spear. Silent actor.
shot-09: Rain lashes; water rises; Oro lifts Pip onto the rock while Tala braces. Silent actors.
shot-10: Gentle firelight flicker; Tala and Oro lean their foreheads together; shadows sway. Silent actors.
shot-11: Slow push-in; Old Blue hops once on the rock beside the other robin; waves roll.
shot-12: Old Blue takes off; more robins rise and follow her upward.
shot-13: The three walk up and crest the ridge; dawn light rises over the plain of fires. Silent actors.
shot-14: Brak emerges from the fog; the woman pauses, then extends the food. Silent actors.
shot-15: Both families settle around the fire; the child looks from one adult to the other. Silent actors.
shot-16: The silhouettes in the bleachers fade away row by row; the viewer stands still. Silent actor.
shot-17: Slow push-in; the viewer lowers their gaze from their hand to the lens. Silent actor, mouth still.
